title: Polynomial hyperbolicity and products of free groups
summary: In this article, we define a locally finite graph $X$ as $η$-polynomially hyperbolic if there exists a Lipschitz map $\varphi : X \to Z$ to some hyperbolic space $Z$ satisfying the following condition: there exists $C \geq 0$ such that $$|B(p,R_1) \cap \varphi^{-1} (B(q,R_2))| \leq (C R_1)^{η(C R_2)} \text{ for all } p,q \in X, R_1,R_2 \geq 0.$$ The picture to keep in mind is that coarse fibres of $\varphi$ have polynomial growth with a degree coarsely controlled by $η$ as the thickness of the fibres grows.
